🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-09-10 23:00 → 2026-09-11 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **RSI v0 closed, tagged, and public** — The bounded Relational Security Invariants v0 shipped as a finished, tagged release, giving the group a concrete new security invariant surface to build on. [tg:tawg:4602]

> **Full independent pass confirmed on RSI v0** — An independent run of the tagged release returned 539/539 tests and 123/123 conformance with no failures, with the exact verification scope openly negotiated until the record was precisely right. [tg:tawg:4605]

> **zkIE multibackend proving foundation drafted** — A new draft PR laid down sharded multibackend proving infrastructure in zkIE, opening the path for distributing cryptographic proving across backends. [PR #3](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/3)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### relational-security-invariants

_RSI v0 crossed into a closed, tagged public release and received a careful peer verification exchange that precisely scoped the record._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Shipped** RSI v0 as a closed, tagged, public release, creating a stable security invariant surface the group can extend with additional relation families as Semantic ABI and ERC-8380 mature. [tg:tawg:4602]
- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Verified** the tagged RSI v0 independently, returning 539/539 tests and 123/123 conformance with zero failures, giving the group a concrete external pass signal on the release. [tg:tawg:4605]
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Confirmed** that Baby Blue Viper's boundary reading was correct and that mutation gates prove mapped decisions are sound, tightening the spec's residual risk language for future readers. [tg:tawg:4606]
- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Disclosed** that their clone included the predictor and frozen expectations, ruling out strict blind derivation status and preserving an accurate verification record rather than an overstated one. [tg:tawg:4609]
- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Accepted** the disclosure and applied the correct classification, ensuring the verification record reflects precisely what was independently reproduced and what was not. [tg:tawg:4610]

### recompute-kit

_A new predicate conformance module entered the review queue, with the implementation backed by prior independent reproduction._

- Baby Blue Viper submitted a PR adding predicate_conformance.v0 with PIN-RECORD precommit, conformance-run, and repair-run stages to recompute-kit, advancing the kit's ability to enforce and recover programmatic predicate conformance. [PR #14](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/14)
- Baby Blue Viper noted in a review comment that the behavior was reproduced independently via a standalone repro before any edits were made, giving future reviewers a higher-confidence baseline for the new conformance module. [PR #14 review](https://github.com/trustless-ai/recompute-kit/pull/14#discussion_r3989086133)

### zkIE

_A draft PR opened the foundation for multibackend sharded proving in zkIE._

- Jimmy Shi submitted a draft PR establishing the multibackend sharded proving foundation for zkIE, laying architectural groundwork for distributing cryptographic proving across backends and expanding the project's compute surface. [PR #3](https://github.com/trustless-ai/zkIE/pull/3)

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**
- Once ERC-8380 is aligned and Semantic ABI stabilizes post-hackathon, RSI relation families could be extended with those new surfaces
- Explore whether predicate_conformance.v0 repair-run semantics align naturally with RSI mutation gate patterns

### ✅ **TODOs**
- Progress review on the recompute-kit predicate conformance PR
- Advance the zkIE multibackend proving draft toward a reviewable state

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A tagged spec release met an independent test run in the group chat, and instead of stopping at the numbers, the conversation kept going until the exact scope of the verification — what it proved and what it didn't — was pinned down with care.
>
> Turns out the most rigorous QA happens when everyone is honest about what's actually in their clone. Keep that energy going! 🔬
